description:
# Summary

This conversation implemented a feature to migrate child chats when moving a parent task to a different Kanban board. The solution adds a checkbox in TaskSettings.vue that appears when a board change is detected and child chats exist, allowing users to automatically update all descendant chats to the new board. A new `migrateChatsToBoard` action was added to the chats store module that recursively updates all child chats, preserves column assignments where possible, and synchronizes the Kanban structure. The implementation includes proper error handling and user notifications to confirm successful migration of child chats.

messages.content:
When changing a chat to another board add the option to migrate all child tree.
If user check migrate children, go through all chats in the tree and change all belonging to same board as the root chat
